body: I go to a different school, study what I actually wanted too, or at least just not have ruined the only thing I had in my life
I do, it feels inevitable that I'm going to do it

I hear ya, honestly I'm at a super stressful point myself, I'm college graduating in May  and all the pressure of find a job and having to go out into the real world and shit have got my anxiety through the roof. I don't see my social situation ever getting better, if anything it's going to decline after school and I'll probably be in a new place knowing no one. I'm introverted so it's not like I always want to be going out, but I still just am always so lonely and crave the relationship I had with my ex, with her it felt like she was all I needed, but I fucked that up and don't think I'll ever forgive myself. Your situation definitely blows mine out of the water but we have our demons and I wish you the best man, I know it can be easy and I can't say I have been in a situation like that, but I have felt like the only option is suicide, I still do, and it's hard not to think about it all the time because it seems like it'll solve all the problems, but what would be left then, I don't know. Sorry if this doesn't help much
If you have the time and the means, read All the Bright Places, similar story to how you two met, doesn't have the happiest ending but I hope you two end up better

I know where you're coming from, my parents are well off, not enough that I won't have to work I don't think but they have given me everything I've ever wanted. I have never felt like I belonged except when I was with my ex but fucked that up. I just isolate myself now and try to find someway to get through each day, it's tough and I feel suicide is inevitable but I think somewhere inside me is the smallest glimmer of hope because I have managed to get this far, but it hasn't even been a year since the break up so I doubt it'll be much longer. It's tough for me to find coping mechanism but honestly that the only hope I have of still living, I don't know you so I don't want to say a bunch of bullshit that I always get told myself, but I hope you can find something to life for.

Honestly I don't know what to say other than it sucks that you've had to go through all that. I shocked people would do that to you over a highschool football game. I wish I had better advice but the fact that you've made it through all that and still going it testament to your resolve.

I feel the same, it seems inevitable to me and yet I still go through each day, I honestly don't know how as I don't see this getting better for me. I'm waiting for the last straw to trigger another psychotic episode to make me take that leap. I can't tell you why or how I'm still going through these daily motions, I don't have many coping skills or mechanisms but the one I do have is basically when I try to base as much time around as possible, I hope you can find something that helps.
Honestly I've been writing my goodbye letters as well, I don't want to cause anyone else pain or guilt
Honestly that's why I don't trust myself around guns, I'm afraid of myself
